“`

“Is that all?”

Qu Zhuang raised an eyebrow.

“Hmm?”

“What do you mean, Brother Qu Zhuang?”

Bian Bo sensed there was more to it and asked.

...

Qu Zhuang exchanged a glance with Liao An and said in a low voice, “Brother Bian Bo, you know that the two of us are responsible for the Black Mist Mountain Range.”

“Right.”

Bian Bo nodded.

“We went to grant amnesty to the Demon Beast Kings of the Black Mist Mountain Range. Those Demon Beast Kings were quite insightful, offering treasures proactively and asking us to take good care of them on the battlefield…”

Qu Zhuang explained.

“There’s such good fortune?”

Bian Bo’s face was full of envy. The Demon Beast Kings of the Myriad Beasts Mountain Range didn’t have that foresight. Forget about offering benefits; they wouldn’t even speak a few kind words.

“Hahahahaha.”

Upon hearing this, Qu Zhuang couldn’t help but smile proudly.

“What kind of treasure did the Demon Beast Kings of the Black Mist Mountain Range actually offer?”

Bian Bo asked with some curiosity.

Seeing Qu Zhuang so pleased, the treasure could not be ordinary.

“Earth Milk.”

Qu Zhuang spoke in a hushed tone.

“Earth Milk?” Bian Bo repeated, somewhat puzzled.

“Million-Year-Old Earth Milk.”

Qu Zhuang added two more words.

“Million-Year-Old Earth Milk?”

Bian Bo’s eyes widened. This was a real treasure, especially for Sixth-Rank cultivators like them, it could have an effect similar to marrow cleansing.

“It’s just a pity.”

“Million-Year-Old Earth Milk cannot be preserved, cannot be taken with us. Liao An and I absorbed it for half a day, struggling until we could no longer continue, and then we left.”

Qu Zhuang shook his head.

“Right.”

“Million-Year-Old Earth Milk, a true miracle of heaven and earth, quickly dissipates once it leaves its birthplace.”

Bian Bo nodded.

This was common knowledge in the realm of cultivation.

But the next moment.

Bian Bo realized something.

“Brother Qu Zhuang, are you saying that there’s some Million-Year-Old Earth Milk left?”

Bian Bo asked tentatively.

“More than just some.”

Qu Zhuang shook his head and said, “By the way, Brother Bian Bo, do you want to go absorb some? It’s a rare opportunity…”

“Thanks, Brother Qu Zhuang.”

Bian Bo was overjoyed.

“It’s just, I need to wait here for the Demon Beast Kings of the Myriad Beasts Mountain Range…”

Bian Bo hesitated.

“What’s so difficult about that, Liao An, you lead Brother Bian Bo to the deepest part of the Black Mist Mountain Range, and I stay here to wait, wouldn’t that work?”

Qu Zhuang patted his chest and said.

“Then…”

“Thanks, Brother Qu Zhuang…”

Bian Bo looked touched. What a good man Brother Qu Zhuang was, not only informing him about the great opportunity of the Million-Year-Old Earth Milk but also waiting here for the Demon Beast Kings on his behalf.

“Go on, go on.”

“Our relationship will grow even closer in the future.”

Qu Zhuang waved his hand dismissively.

“Of course.”

Bian Bo nodded affirmatively.

…

In front of a verdant lake,

an elder with a goat beard stood quietly, surveying the lake.

“Four hundred years ago, the Foreign Evil God appeared outside of the world, causing many powers of the Tianqing World to tremble. Among them, the Xuanwu Beast King, known as one of the Four Divine Beast Kings, lies in slumber here.”

“Before the Xuanwu Beast King went into slumber, it made a pact with the Alliance Hierarch, saying that if one day there was a great matter related to the Foreign Evil God that required its aid, it need only be asked…”

The elder with the goat beard mused to himself.

He was a protector of the Tianqing Alliance, a Sixth-Rank Peak Powerhouse. His mission to enter the Tianqing World this time was specifically to awaken the Xuanwu Beast King.

“Hm?”

Just then, the elder with the goat beard glanced at the distance.

“Uncle, Uncle, it’s me.”

A figure flew quickly towards him; it was ‘Bian Bo’.

“Little Bo…”

The elder with the goat beard nodded slightly.

As a high-ranking member of the Tianqing Alliance, the elder with the goat beard would occasionally lend a helping hand to his descendants and juniors.

Bian Bo was the most promising among his offspring.

“What’s the matter?”

The elder with the goat beard asked directly.

He had the task of awakening the Xuanwu Beast King and could not afford to delay for too long.

“`

“I have a friend who went to the Black Mist Mountain Range to recruit the Demon Beast Kings there to go to the Evil God Battlefield…”

Bian Bo began to speak.

“I know of this.”

The old man with the goat beard nodded.

The Vice Alliance Hierarchs and protectors who had returned from the Evil God Battlefield each had their own tasks to undertake.

“Uncle, guess what my friend found in the Black Mist Mountain Range.”

As Bian Bo said this, he carefully looked around.

“Found what?”

The old man with the goat beard asked, somewhat amused.

“The He Tao Flower, a thousand-year-old He Tao Flower.”

Bian Bo lowered his voice and spoke seriously.

“A thousand-year He Tao Flower?”

The old man with the goat beard’s pupils tightened.

A cultivator at the Sixth Rank Peak wishing to break through to the Seventh Rank needed, apart from their own understanding of the Great Dao, the help of rare items like the thousand-year He Tao Flower to shorten or even skip the process.

The old man with the goat beard, being a Sixth-Rank Peak Powerhouse, dreamt of breaking through to the Seventh Rank. Unfortunately, his natural talent was not sufficient. If nothing unexpected happened, he estimated that he would never touch the Seventh Rank.

But now…

He saw hope.

The thousand-year He Tao Flower.

If he could get his hands on that He Tao Flower, entering the Seventh Rank was a certainty.

At that time…

Based on his past merits and his relationships with a few Vice Alliance Hierarchs…

The old man with the goat beard would become the twelfth Vice Alliance Hierarch of the Tianqing Alliance.

“Is this true?”

The old man with the goat beard looked at Bian Bo, “And, since it’s a thousand-year He Tao Flower, why don’t you keep it for yourself, instead of telling me?”

Although the old man with the goat beard had provided much help to Bian Bo…

In the face of such a great chance to step into the Seventh Rank, let alone that the two were uncle and nephew; even if they were father and son, a falling out could occur.

“Uncle…

“The eight Demon Beast Kings of the Black Mist Mountain Range joined forces to monopolize the He Tao Flower. I couldn’t get my hands on it.”

“That’s why I came to tell Uncle.”

Bian Bo explained.

“Why not report it to the Alliance?” the old man with the goat beard asked.

“Report it to the Alliance? How much benefit can they give me?”

“It’s better to tell Uncle, and when Uncle steps into the Seventh Rank and becomes a Vice Alliance Hierarch, just don’t forget about little Bo.”

Fear appeared on Bian Bo’s face in a timely manner.

“I see.”

The old man with the goat beard nodded slightly.

That made sense.

It wasn’t that Bian Bo didn’t want the He Tao Flower.

It was that he simply couldn’t get it, and if he continued to drag things out, he reckoned it would be devoured by those few Demon Beast Kings.

“These Demon Beast Kings, a bunch of good-for-nothings, we humans are on the battlefield resisting the invasion of the Evil God, while these beasts are enjoying themselves in the rear. The treasures like the He Tao Flower should naturally belong to us humans, yet they think of monopolizing it.”

The old man with the goat beard became furious, “Little Bo, take me there. I want to see which Demon Beast Kings dare to monopolize the He Tao Flower.”

The old man with the goat beard immediately went with Bian Bo to the Black Mist Mountain Range.

As for awakening the Xuanwu Beast King… that wasn’t urgent, and there would be no harm in waiting until the He Tao Flower was in hand.

…

Several days later.

Atop a high mountain.

A tall man stood with his hands behind his back.

“This place seals one of the strongest foundations of Tianqing World, a War Machine that can dominate all…”

The tall man was somewhat emotional.

As a Vice Alliance Hierarch of the Tianqing Alliance, second in status only to the Alliance Hierarch, only he had the ‘authority’ needed to activate this foundation.

“Mr. Gao.”

“Mr. Gao.”

“I have a major discovery to report to you.”

At this moment, a beam of Escape Light flew rapidly in.

It was the old man with the goat beard.

“What major discovery?”

Mr. Gao turned his head, glancing at the old man with the goat beard.

In the Tianqing Alliance, the old man with the goat beard was under his command, and the two had a relatively close relationship.

“I have a nephew, who found traces of a World Weapon in the Black Mist Mountain Range…”

After casting a spell to prevent eavesdropping, the old man with the goat beard spoke in a low voice.

…..

Half a year later.

In the depths of the Black Mist Mountain Range.

All twelve of the Tianqing Alliance’s Vice Alliance Hierarchs, thirty-three protectors, one hundred fifty-six elders, the Four Holy Beast Kings, and ninety-three Demon Beast Kings, stood there respectfully.

They answered Lin Yuan’s questions about the secrets of Tianqing World.

Looking down at the sixteen Seventh-Rank Powerhouses, eighty-eight Sixth-Rank Peak Powerhouses, and one hundred ninety-four Sixth-Rank Powerhouses, Lin Yuan fell into contemplation, his heart inevitably stirred.

Who would have thought that I, a lackey sent in by the Foreign Evil God, would take control of the entire Tianqing World?
